contracts.identity: journal_epoch + sequential uint64 operation ID; next admission must equal highwater+1
contracts.manual_and_scheduled: Same owner; scheduled origin synthetic only, not a scheduler
contracts.actuation: Synthetic HAL only; no physical motor/GPIO implementation
contracts.recovery: Admitted -> aborted/not_started; intent and other unfinished effect-bearing states -> indeterminate/owner_lost; no replay/resume
contracts.blocked_history: Failed/indeterminate/global safety fault blocks new admissions; no automatic clear
contracts.local_interface: Root-only mode-0600 Unix SOCK_SEQPACKET; versioned bounded commands, no network listener or complete remote API
contracts.events: Latest committed op_event, not an independent durable event stream

journal.format: Canonical explicit little-endian fields with CRC32 and structural/schema validation
journal.commit_protocol: Validate old snapshot/marker; write temporary; fsync(file); rename; fsync(directory); exact readback; acknowledge
journal.actual_nor_erase_wear: Not measured; logical bytes exclude compression, metadata and garbage collection

resources.measurements: Point-in-time guest process resources and monotonic synthetic operation durations, not peak RSS or physical mechanism timing

significant_safeguards: Durable effect fence precedes the sole HAL start path; delayed fence cannot issue a start using stale time.
Health rechecks monotonic time after subsystem callbacks before watchdog servicing.
Fresh stopped observation required after stop submission; unknown stop remains indeterminate.
Duplicate/conflicting/retired IDs cannot cause replay; generation/deadline tokens reject stale success while retaining uncertainty.
Rejected partial journal records are cleared before diagnostic formatting.
Journal corruption faults feeding while preserving secure SSH diagnostics when the outer state schema is valid.
limitations: No physical actuation, electrical thresholds, board driver qualification, food mass or dual-bowl hardware guarantee.
101 process-kill windows and injected ENOSPC/EIO do not prove physical power-loss atomicity or actual flash-exhaustion behavior.
Old pinned JFFS2 fsync does not propagate every internal write-buffer flush result; readback is not a physical durability proof.
CRC detects corruption, not malicious rewriting or rollback to an older valid journal. Independent anti-rollback anchoring is absent.
Interrupted fresh-journal initialization fails closed if the marker exists without a trustworthy snapshot; operator recovery is not automated.
No authenticated operator reconciliation/clearance API for failed or indeterminate outcomes yet; deleting state is not a supported recovery procedure.
No full scheduling, native network API, media, BLE, OTA or Home Assistant adapter implementation.
Default watchdog remains simulated. Standard SP805 module still unbound; separate modeled reset is not health-gated Linux or physical watchdog coverage.
OEM bootloader remains a separate retained dependency; no physical feeder operations performed.
